name: YouTube API Metadata
description: Provides YouTube metadata (title, description, thumbnails, channel info, stats) via the official YouTube Data API v3, without depending on yt-dlp. Requires Jellyfin 12.x; not compatible with Jellyfin 10.11.x or earlier.
overview: YouTube metadata provider using the official YouTube Data API v3

versions.changelog: Fix: the API key is now read on every call, so a key saved in the settings page works immediately instead of only after a restart (0.3.0.0 and earlier always used the key present at startup - empty on a fresh install - and every lookup failed with "No YouTube Data API v3 key configured"). Lookups are now logged (handle/name searches, hit counts, picked channel). Includes 0.3.0.0: channel-name and @handle search for series folders, title search for video files, full channel/video metadata (keywords, topics, country, banner images).
Ported to Jellyfin 12.0 (net10.0, Jellyfin.Controller/Jellyfin.Data 12.0.0). Drops Jellyfin 10.11.x support.
